{{further|2024 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA 1000 tournaments]], make up the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organized by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tennis Tournaments {{!}} Official WTA Tournaments – WTA Tennis |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2024 |access-date=2023-11-14 |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=2024 WTA 1000 Calendar |url=https://wtafiles.wtatennis.com/pdf/calendar/calendar.pdf |access-date=14 November 2023 |website=wtatennis.com}}</ref> This is the first year when all ten WTA 1000 tournaments are mandatory.
